_comment: Eyebrow weight-role ratchet baseline (design-system consistency CD-02). The count of uppercase-tracked eyebrows across web/src (outside design/), measured by countUppercaseTrackedEyebrows() in consistencyAudit.report.ts: a non-comment line that pairs `uppercase` with a WIDENING tracking utility (tracking-wide/wider/widest or an arbitrary tracking-[…]). The Weight-First rule (web/DESIGN.md §3/§6) bans uppercase-with-tracking; the canonical treatment is the sentence-case `caption` role, vended as the Eyebrow primitive (ui/Eyebrow.tsx). eyebrowWeightRole.test.ts asserts the live count may only be <= this — a NEW tracked eyebrow turns CI red, but the frozen backlog does not block. As surfaces migrate to Eyebrow, RATCHET THIS DOWN (lower the number in the SAME commit). It may only shrink. 131 is the count after FIX-1 migrated the top three offenders — LoopCockpitPage (10), MemoryPanel (9), CodeCockpitPage (8) — from a starting 158.
